programme.title: BSc in Computer Science
programme.campus: Abu Dhabi, UAE (Khalifa University; programme page names no specific campus)
programme.how_found: site-restricted web search (ku.ac.ae) for the BSc Computer Science programme; the guessed department URL returned 404. Teaching language from the undergraduate admissions FAQ: 'All applicants must demonstrate proficiency in English, the language of instruction at KU.'
programme.quote: The BSc in Computer Science program is concerned with the theoretical foundations of information and computation.

english.quote: Yes. All applicants must meet the English requirement by submitting an Academic IELTS score of 6.0 or a TOEFL iBT score of 79.
english.how_found: Undergraduate admissions FAQ (ku.ac.ae), confirmed by the 'Mandatory English Proficiency Test' table on the undergraduate admissions page (IELTS Academic 6.0 OR TOEFL iBT 79).
english.notes: Academic IELTS only. EmSAT English is not in the current mandatory table; an older section of the same FAQ page (written for the Fall 2024 cycle) lists 'Dircte Admissions: IETS 6.0 – TOFEL IBT 79 – EmSAT English 1400' and conditional admission at IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 70 / EmSAT 1250, so EmSAT and conditional figures are left out as possibly out of date. Same page: 'No. Meeting the English requirement is mandatory to enroll.'

value.description: No grade threshold is published for Kazakhstan / NIS. The listed curricula have their own minimums (e.g. American/CBSE 80% in Mathematics and one science subject; 'Russian or equivalent' minimum 4.0 in the final year, grade 11); anything not listed falls under 'Other Not Listed: Conditions apply according to the admission's policy set by Khalifa University.' The published test-score route for Mathematics is SAT Math 625 (Subject Tests table), with SAT Math 700 listed as 'Preferable Test (Strengthens Application)'.

gpa.quote: Admissions to the university is competitive, and meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee final admission. Final decisions are based on the selected program and the availability of seats.
gpa.how_found: Undergraduate admissions page, 'Step 3: Review the admission requirements' (curriculum table and 'Submission of Programs Requirements / Subject Tests' table).
gpa.notes: How admission is decided: shortlisted applicants take the KU Admission Test (KUAT) and submit a recorded video interview; 'The admission department will make recommendations regarding the qualified applicants through an internal process based on the admission assessments results and high school grades.' The CS programme needs English, Mathematics and one of Physics/Chemistry/Biology. Whether KU treats NIS grade 12 as 'Russian or equivalent' or 'Other Not Listed' is not stated; ask ugadmissions@ku.ac.ae. Applicants must have graduated within the last two years, and an equivalency certificate is required for international school systems.

deadline.quote: The application will close on 2 March 2026 - Apply before this date to be considered for admission.
deadline.how_found: Site-restricted web search for the Fall 2026 deadline, leading to the Fall 2026 undergraduate admission page (timeline: 'Mar 2, 2026 ... Application Deadline').
deadline.notes: This is the FALL 2026 cycle deadline, not Fall 2027. On 2026-10-17 the main undergraduate admissions page says 'Undergraduate admissions will not be offered for Spring 2027. Applications for Fall 2027 will open soon.' and 'Stay tuned for the Fall 2027 application timeline'. The Fall 2026 cycle opened to international applicants on Nov 17, 2025, so a similar Nov–Mar window is likely for 2027, but that is not confirmed.

tuition.quote: Fee Per Credit Hour Approximate Amount Per Year ( 12 – 16 credits) Bachelor Tuition 2,500 AED 81,250 AED
tuition.how_found: Undergraduate admissions page, 'Tuition Fees: Undergraduate' table; confirmed by the official tuition fees page ('Preparatory and Undergraduate AED 2,500 per credit hour').
tuition.notes: The quote is the fee table flattened into one line of text. The page gives an approximate yearly figure based on credit hours (AED 2,500 per credit hour); it names no academic year and makes no national/international distinction. Tuition fees page: '*The University reserves the right to change the above tuition fees'. Housing is extra (e.g. double occupancy AED 10,000 per Fall/Spring term).

scholarship_exists.quote: International students are evaluated and mapped to a specific scholarship Tier on the basis of academic merit and other relevant factors, in line with Khalifa University’s strategic priorities, rules and regulations.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Linked from 'Step 4: Review our scholarships' on the undergraduate admissions page; the Undergraduate Scholarships page.
scholarship_exists.notes: Tiers: I full tuition + textbooks; II 75% tuition waiver; III 50%; IV 25%; V textbooks only. No separate application: eligibility is assessed with the admission application. Slots are limited, and meeting the minimum criteria does not guarantee an award. The international tiers do not list accommodation (the UAE-national scholarship does).

scholarship_international.quote: Khalifa University of Science and Technology offers the following scholarships to support qualified UAE national and international students enrolled in undergraduate programs on a full-time basis.
scholarship_international.notes: The same page has a separate section, 'SCHOLARSHIPS FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS'.
